*microscopic_floquet_model*

$$
H_I=\sum_j(J\sigma_j^z\sigma_{j+1}^z+h_j\sigma_j^z),\quad H_K=b\sum_j\sigma_j^x,\quad U_{KI}=e^{-iH_K}e^{-iH_I}
$$

status: `verified` · source: equation: Main Eqs. (1)-(3); tex_label: ham, hamiltonians, floquet

Numerical form:

